name: Coral Magnesium
headline: Coral Magnesium
description: A source of magnesium, one of the body's most important minerals. It has a calming effect on the nervous system and helps regulate muscle tone and heart rhythm; the organic glycinate and taurate forms used here give it good bioavailability.
howToUse: Adults – 1-2 capsules a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Magnesium taurate and magnesium glycinate, gelatin (capsule), magnesium salt of stearic acid (stabiliser).
